about: Cast plan for the layered-rig cut-out animation: which painted characters appear in each poem, their posed whole-figure paintings, marker coverage, master candidates per view and gaps. Built from stage/plans/NN.json shot text + stage/timeline/NN.json scene times, kits/cut/catalog.json sheets (with poems), bodylab/body.json, rig/poses/*.json, and a visual check of every whole-figure card.
notes: storyboard_data.js (41 panels) describes settings only; director_notes.json and cartoon_sequences.json concern world-footage shots, not these characters - neither adds cast evidence beyond POET/DJ/EX mentions.
"clipped" = the cutter split the figure with a straight vertical line (half a figure on the card); markers exist but the card is unusable as a master.
Screen time = sum of scene durations (timeline t0..t1) of the scenes a character is in; a character in a scene is counted for the whole scene.
Views follow the Pose Lab solver labels (front / threequarter / profile / back) where a solve exists; otherwise by eye.
